pages.text: $(italic)Survival investment. Every class benefits; Vanguard and Paladin can't do without it.$()$(br2)28 nodes: an 8-node trunk, then two branches of 10, each ending in a capstone. Every node costs 1 point, the capstones too.$(br2)Every node is an attribute and applies the moment you take it.

pages.title: Trunk
pages.text: $(bold)Constitution$() I and II: +4 max health (2 hearts) each$(br2)$(bold)Tough Skin$() I and II: +4% damage resistance each$(br2)$(bold)Regeneration$() I and II: +5% healing received each$(br2)$(bold)Steady Footing$() I and II: +15% knockback resistance each

pages.title: Resilience Branch
pages.text: $(bold)Enduring Body$() I to IV: +6, +6, +8 and +8 max health (3, 3, 4 and 4 hearts)$(br)$(bold)Armor Mastery$() I to III: +1 armor toughness each$(br)$(bold)Elemental Resistance$() I and II: +4% damage resistance each, against every kind of damage$(br2)$(bold)Capstone: Unbreakable$(), +10 max health (5 hearts), +2 armor toughness and +6% damage resistance.

pages.title: Regeneration Branch
pages.text: $(bold)Recovery$() I to IV: +8%, +8%, +10% and +10% healing received$(br)$(bold)Natural Regen$() I to III: +5%, +5% and +10% natural regeneration, the healing a full food bar gives$(br)$(bold)Stamina$() I and II: +1 stamina each. A food point lasts 5 exhaustion instead of 4, then 6.$(br2)$(bold)Capstone: Undying$(), +15% healing received, +10% natural regeneration and +2 stamina.
